title: The Doctor Who Transcripts - The Deadly Assassin

rooms.name: TARDIS Console Room
rooms.description: A wooden console room within the TARDIS, featuring a hexagonal console and various compartments. The Doctor experiences a vision here, foreseeing an assassination. The room is equipped with a viewscreen and contains a small writing desk and a Gladstone bag.
events: The Doctor has a vision of the assassination
The Doctor writes a warning note

rooms.name: Gallifrey - Sector 7
rooms.description: An area outside the Capitol on Gallifrey, where the TARDIS materializes. It is patrolled by Chancery guards and is the site of an unauthorized capsule entry alert. The Doctor is pursued by guards here.
events: The TARDIS materializes
The Doctor evades capture

rooms.name: Records Room
rooms.description: A room in the Capitol where data on Time Lords and TARDIS capsules is stored and accessed. It features a computer system for data retrieval and a storage area for data tubes.
events: Spandrell investigates the Doctor's TARDIS
Engin retrieves data on the Doctor

rooms.name: Chancellery
rooms.description: The administrative center of the Capitol, where high-ranking Time Lords, including Chancellor Goth, discuss matters of state. It features a fur-covered chair and is a place of political intrigue.
events: Spandrell discusses the Doctor's warning with Goth

rooms.name: Panopticon
rooms.description: The central ceremonial hall of the Time Lords, where the President's resignation ceremony takes place. It is a grand space with high galleries and a circular central dais. The assassination occurs here.
events: The President is assassinated
The Doctor is captured

rooms.name: Panopticon Gallery
rooms.description: A high gallery overlooking the Panopticon, used by the Doctor to observe the ceremony. It is where the assassination weapon is set up.
events: The Doctor discovers the assassination weapon

rooms.name: Panopticon Antechamber
rooms.description: A room adjacent to the Panopticon where the President prepares for the ceremony. It contains ceremonial items and is a place of preparation.
events: The President prepares for the ceremony

rooms.name: Museum
rooms.description: A location within the Capitol where the TARDIS is transducted. It contains displays of Time Lord regalia and is a place of historical significance.
events: The Doctor disguises himself in Time Lord robes

rooms.name: Detention Room
rooms.description: A secure room where the Doctor is held and interrogated. It features a cage on a pillar and a retractable walkway. The Doctor is tortured here.
events: The Doctor is interrogated and tortured

rooms.name: Matrix - Betchworth Quarry
rooms.description: A virtual location within the Matrix, resembling a quarry with loose chalk and a precipice. The Doctor encounters a Samurai warrior here.
events: The Doctor is attacked by a Samurai warrior

rooms.name: Matrix - Operating Theatre
rooms.description: A surreal operating theatre within the Matrix, featuring an oxygen mask and a masked surgeon with a large syringe. The Doctor is threatened with an injection.
events: The Doctor escapes an injection

rooms.name: Matrix - World War One Battlefield
rooms.description: A virtual battlefield within the Matrix, with explosions and railway tracks. The Doctor is trapped by moving points and narrowly escapes an oncoming train.
events: The Doctor escapes an oncoming train

rooms.name: Matrix - Railway Junction
rooms.description: An intersection of railway tracks within the Matrix, where the Doctor encounters three concealed train drivers. The Doctor's foot is trapped by moving points.
events: The Doctor frees his foot from the tracks

rooms.name: Matrix - Cliff Face
rooms.description: A cliff face within the Matrix, where the Doctor hides from a hunter. The area is populated by birds and a giant spider.
events: The Doctor hides from a hunter

rooms.name: Matrix - Valley
rooms.description: A valley within the Matrix, where the Doctor encounters a hunter. The area is filled with foliage and is a place of pursuit.
events: The Doctor is pursued by a hunter

rooms.name: Matrix - Reed Thicket
rooms.description: A thicket within the Matrix, where the Doctor hides from a hunter. The area is dense with reeds and provides cover.
events: The Doctor hides in the thicket

rooms.name: Matrix - Pool
rooms.description: A pool within the Matrix, where the Doctor discovers poisoned water. He uses a reed to drink safely from the margins.
events: The Doctor drinks safely from the pool

rooms.name: Matrix - Marsh
rooms.description: A marshy area within the Matrix, where the Doctor struggles to keep moving. The area is filled with marsh gas and is treacherous.
events: The Doctor navigates the marsh

rooms.name: Adytum
rooms.description: A secretive location where the decaying figure of the Master resides. It is a place of plotting and control, featuring a couch and a red metal helmet.
events: The Master plots against the Doctor

rooms.name: Panopticon Vault
rooms.description: A vault beneath the Panopticon, containing the bodies of the President and Chancellor Goth. It is a place of death and concealment.
events: The Master revives and escapes
